_comment: HSBC: key = last 6 digits of the masked account; the full number is 007032 + those 6 digits. SCB/BRAC: key = full account number. account_head = exact ERP head text. DEDUCTION = default head for Deductions at Source rows. EBL: key = full account number from the sheet (MARGIN CORP. 220600009, UGL ERQ 1043100450368, margin on other import obligations 220600017, UGL CD 1111060214910). DEDUCTION:<label in lower case> = head for one kind of deduction row (e.g. DEDUCTION:other bank charges); it wins over DEDUCTION. SCB: every USD credit is merged into 01130769902 (BTB head). EBL: margin + margin on other import obligations merge on 220600009 (BTB head), ERQ 1043100450368 -> ERQ Account. All deductions use DEDUCTION = Foreign Collection Charge.
